usage: The word '烏蠅' is used to refer to the insect 'fly' in Cantonese.
'烏蠅' is always a noun and cannot be used as a verb or adjective.
You can use '烏蠅' as the subject or object in a sentence.
When describing something annoying or dirty involving flies, '烏蠅' is commonly used.
'烏蠅' can appear in casual daily conversations to talk about pests or hygiene.
